Senses.Explanation: The light-and-realm couplet of the Chan records: the mind-moon lone and round, swallowing the ten thousand forms — light that shines on no realm, realms that do not remain — and the question pressed after: when both are forgotten, what thing is it? Panshan Baoji ascends the hall of Youzhou and the couplet is born: the mind-moon lone and round, swallowing the ten thousand forms — the light shines on no realm, the realms do not remain — light and realm both gone: what thing is it? Cuiyan Shouzhi raises the verse before his assembly and turns his own whisk: the dust-grain buddhas' bright light is all inside this — shining through your liver and five viscera; before the patch-robe monk it must not be spoken of; best keep your mouth shut, Baiyun Shouduan sets the couplet down and takes up his staff: this staff — meeting the honored it turns cheap, meeting the cheap it turns honored. How so? Who knows that inside the cold ash the nine-turned scent threads the vase? Qiyuan Xinggang holds the fifteenth-day tea service: before the fifteenth, the great earth's hills and streams all have their moon; after the fifteenth, whose stove lacks smoke? Today, just the fifteenth — heaven's moon round, the human world calling it half-month. The so-called mind-moon lone and round, swallowing the ten thousand forms — light shining on no realm, realms not remaining; both forgotten, what thing is it? The hall elder offers the old answer — to say it is like some thing will not do — and she presses: in the end, what is it? Many meet; few know the sound — she strikes, Hanyu Hongxian runs it through the hall: the bright taboo of empty space, groundlessly standing its indictments — the couplet: a wedge driven into the eye, a nail drawn behind the head. Both forgotten, what thing is it? Hearing with the eye first true, seeing with the ear first sure — the ancient worthy did not hide the straight; does anyone beside me refuse? Say it plainly and earn your one eye, Foyuan Chegang completes the seven-lamps service: so the mind-moon hangs lone, swallowing the ten thousand forms — light shining on no realm, realms not remaining; both forgotten, what thing is it? The staff comes down: this one stretch bright of itself — on a hair-tip no shadow can escape. Does it rise from vow-power, pour out from self-nature?
